issues.title: Movement blocked with no visible obstacle

limitations: Player collision geometry and exact movement step size are unknown.
Forty-eight entities are omitted from the step-160 view; however, the initial observation shows no other entity at the door location.
No feedback message explains the blockage.
Only three consecutive steps are provided; earlier approach path is not shown.
assessment.title: Movement blocked with no visible obstacle
assessment.playerImpact: Player at [-0.75, 1, 1.85] cannot move east through an open doorway (door at x=0, z=1–3, solid=false), blocking progression toward the exit at x=4. No visible solid entity intersects the player's forward path in the provided entity lists.
assessment.rationale: Step 159 moves player east 1.1 units to [-0.75, 1, 1.85]. Step 160 attempts another east move from that position but yields zero displacement. The step-160 before-state lists the door at [0, 1.25, 2] size [0.5, 2.5, 2] with state open=true, solid=false, spanning z≈1–3 — the player's z=1.85 lies within this opening. Adjacent walls (wall-interior-3 at z=0, wall-interior-4 at z=4) are outside the player's z. Floors are at y=-0.13, below the player. No feedback or solid obstacle appears in the included entities. The reset at step 161 confirms the session can restart but does not resolve the blockage.
